selection: context_policy.model_selection is an exact provider_id/model_id object; explicit selection only dispatches the registered configured adapter and never silently falls back. Automatic routing retains the declared active/fallback policy. Legacy provider_model is accepted only if equal to the selected or active configured model.
sampling: Optional finite numeric context_policy.temperature in [0,2] binds to the immutable execution request and provider request. Only known OpenAI gpt-4o/gpt-4.1 hosted families support it; automatic routing requires every declared route to support it. Unsupported sampling fails before provider dispatch.
startup: Only engine bootstrap opts into retain_unavailable. Local activation failures retain a non-dispatchable descriptor with no model identity and stable safe readiness code. Default registry construction remains fail-closed; local mode never falls through to hosted inference.
catalog: Registry statuses are the sole authority for conservative engine chat policy capabilities and limits; route and backend expose allowlisted projections without model, network or credential probes.
validation: Source validation and actual first-install and canonical model workloads; no automated tests per user instruction.

checkpoint_binding.before_dispatch: Initial checkpoint binds execution_id/request identity/tenant, ordered generator routes, configured provider/model pair, secret-free endpoint/config identity, local model/runtime/profile/manifest/default-seed identities, separately configured verifier and canonical code/Python/package pins. Checkpoint precedes provider dispatch.
checkpoint_binding.recovery: Every unfinished resume and dispatch compares the entire pinned identity bundle. Legacy unfinished checkpoints missing the binding fail closed; never retrofitted. Completed historical results remain readable.
checkpoint_binding.response_admission: Response provider/model must exactly match one configured pair in the pinned declared route set; direct explicit selection has exactly one route. Automatic fallback membership admits successful declared secondary without accepting arbitrary providers.
checkpoint_binding.secrets: No API keys, raw endpoint URLs, filesystem paths, headers or proxy credentials in durable binding; endpoint SHA256 only
checkpoint_binding.limitations: Pins configured adapter/model identity; hosted vendor adapters normalize configured model names. This does not attest remote vendor weights or local shared-library integrity beyond current canonical artifact receipts.
checkpoint_binding.local_reference_integrity: Recompute actual reference model canonical order/transitions content hash on each binding/assert, reject mismatch with claimed cached model_digest. Neural digest already hashes actual arrays; standalone runtime verifies pinned artifacts per dispatch.

local_budget_guard.before_compute: Exact reference tokens from full LocalInferenceRequest.rendered_input; UTF8 bytes+BOS for native neural; conservative full owned rendered-prompt UTF8 bytes+BOS for standalone GGUF. Input mustfit request.resource_budget.max_input_tokens. Requested output mustfit max_output_tokens; absent output defaults min(256,budget).
local_budget_guard.wall: Every local dispatch has a finite ResourceBudget.max_wall_seconds ceiling; earlier explicit deadline wins; cooperative cancellation drains real worker. No unbounded deadline-free dispatch.
local_budget_guard.authority: Existing engine admission remains quota authority; no new admission/store/provider owner.

backend_prompt_admission.authority: Existing canonical ContextCompiler/model-catalog budgets and EngineClient only; no additional provider, transport or fallback.
backend_prompt_admission.invariant: The exact current USER segment ID/content SHA must be present in selected evidence_segments and project_provider_context must materialize exactly the requested current prompt. source_snapshot is an input inventory and cannot prove selection; omitted input never reaches local request construction or engine admission.
backend_prompt_admission.failure: EngineTextContextError (existing EngineTextError subclass, code engine_context_too_small) reports a bounded context-capacity failure without prompt/source text. Complete rendered local framing must also fit the selected canonical input budget; no budget relaxation or token heuristic replacement.

current_main_compatibility.context_keys: Canonical new commands use model_selection/temperature. Existing main commands may use provider_selection/provider_temperature. One canonical resolver validates either spelling, rejects unequal dual keys and never silently ignores explicit selection or sampling. Original prepared request bytes and digest remain unchanged on replay.
current_main_compatibility.provider_inventory: Existing engine provider inventory remains the sole status authority. Backend tenant_model_inventory(actor_id,tenant_id) adapts the current scoped client contract to that same tenant-authorized endpoint and allowlisted projection; no global status fallback, new route, provider probe or credential exposure.
current_main_compatibility.preserved_main_capabilities: Keep main exact lease tokens, historical prepared-request read adapters, graceful backend signal forwarding, neural train_document and bounded input, engine CORS, Dragon native/world routes, native savestate/rewind/branch multimodal receipts and CLI entrypoints.
current_main_compatibility.authority: Existing canonical owners/interfaces only; no new provider boundary, service or state owner.
